purpose: Permanent behavioral canary for worker orchestration changes. It should be cheap enough to run routinely and strict enough to catch the regressions that historically looked like architectural progress.

short_suite.test: Resident worker completes several easy tasks through repeated SUBMIT_AND_NEXT without re-bootstrap.
Capacity-overflow worker receives NO_WORK/WAIT and cannot steal protected scope.
Duplicate/late submit cannot create two accepted completions.
Expired incarnation result is rejected or reconciled without corrupting accepted successor work.
Abandoned task becomes safely recoverable and is completed once.
Fresh incarnation continues a durable logical slot without human recap and without repeating completed tasks.
Worker cannot mutate/claim another protected grid/scope.
DONE and PASS remain separately measurable; intentionally bad output is not promoted.
Run remains correct with projection/TV disabled.
Clean autonomous run completes with zero human routing/recap/merge actions.

arms.description: Reconstruct the simplest resident pool semantics.
Modern durable leases/recovery/evidence hidden behind minimal worker ABI.

full_experiment_candidate.freeze_rule: No material runtime/prompt/evaluator changes inside a measured epoch. Change => new version/epoch or contaminated classification.
full_experiment_candidate.promotion_rule: Candidate C may replace a production path only after it preserves safety/authority invariants, has zero cross-grid/lost-task corruption in the qualifying runs, reincarnates without human recap, and independently reproduces performance/quality that is materially no worse than the simple baseline.

e0_interpretation.external_launch_gap: separate from backend runtime admission failure until session observed

implementation_note: Grid Lab v2 executable substrate is deployed and synthetic smoke passed. C/E0 is armed. Full harness is NOT promoted: real 21-chat C/E0, real fresh-chat reincarnation, later A/B comparison and blind/repeatability epochs remain evidence-gated.
